fact: Acting Minister Dikoloti told Parliament that under NDP 12 the Ministry of Lands and Agriculture will upgrade the Land Information System and the Integrated Geographic Information System (IGIS), and announced a planned Electronic Deeds Registration Systems Act to give a legal framework for digital registration.

Vice President and Finance Minister Gaolathe said in the 2026/27 Budget Speech that Government will begin, through the Geospatial Information Centre, the first phase of a four-year programme to upgrade the Land Information System and strengthen the Integrated Geographic Information System.
